verdict: Independent evaluation attempted but incomplete; uncounted faults or control execution errors remain.
inputReport:
Fictional salon report: booking integrity

I booked Box braids for Saturday 5 January 2030 at 2 p.m. The page said "Booking confirmed", but when I reopened the page my appointment was gone. I expect a confirmed booking to really be saved: still listed when I come back, shown only to me, and still there later.

expectations.statement: After a booking is confirmed and the page is reopened, the appointment is still listed.
The appointment appears under the customer who booked it, and not under any other customer.
"Booking confirmed" is shown only when the booking has actually been saved by the salon's system.
A saved appointment is still there after the server restarts.
The listed appointment shows the date and time that was booked.

limitations: Development results are not independent evaluation.
Missing comparator roles are absent, not invented baselines.
Local execution is not a hostile-code sandbox.
Fault qualification assumes reviewed probe requirements correctly establish the declared violation.

independent.label: Independent evaluation recorded; inspect its completeness and counts.
